text:
Stonehill men's soccer falls to UMass in 1-0 non-conference match
P. A. Owens
The Stonehill men's soccer team lost a close 1-0 match to non-conference opponent UMass on Sept. 16 in Easton, Massachusetts.
Sophomore goalkeeper Felix van der Hagen made six saves for the Skyhawks. Seniors Chris Hines and Ethan O'Connor each recorded two shots, while junior Nate Monteiro also contributed with a pair of shots off the bench.
The match was physical from the outset, with both teams unable to score during the first half. The teams entered halftime tied at zero. UMass scored the game's only goal in the 55th minute. Van der Hagen made a significant save in the 67th minute to keep Stonehill within one goal.
Late in the game, Stonehill increased its offensive pressure. Freshman Hayden Xhokaxhiu had an opportunity to tie the game in the 78th minute, but UMass goalkeeper Dean Linden made a save.
Stonehill is scheduled to play its next match against Holy Cross on Wednesday, September 23, at 6 p.m. in Worcester, Massachusetts.
